prep.summary: Your last sync with James on July 14 highlights unresolved AWS Connect confusion—specifically Track 2 and 3 production goals—and details your pitch to Anne Heinz for the IP-initiated asynchronous messaging proof of concept. Reviewing meetings from the past week reveals critical conflicts over the D&S two-way SMS strategy—where you must defend the limited Phoenix pilot against the business's risky November 30 release timeline—and demands strict adherence to the notifications-only security mandate.
tasks: Align with Charlotte to clarify target requirements and establish clear POC boundaries for the AWS native workspace.
Follow up with Anne Heinz regarding the protocol swap security review for the Apple Messages for Business pilot.
Enforce the manual compensating controls for the 100-user Phoenix pilot to bypass immediate inline Data Loss Prevention automation blocks.
Reject the November 30 "Big Bang" release plan proposed by the business to mitigate operational risk prior to the code freeze.

prep.summary: You drove critical momentum across Claims UX initiatives—navigating a 38% reduction in Guidewire activities and initiating a 90-day push for Capgemini design concepts—while managing resource disputes between business funding and IT leadership. You established key architectural partnerships with the new Property Product Development team to accelerate speed-to-market efforts through the foundry concept. You also prepared high-stakes technical briefings for executive leadership—specifically detailing the governance of 4,500 active applications—amid broader staff feedback calling for reduced organizational complexity and faster execution.
tasks: Resolve the IT capacity dispute with Dan Griffiths regarding the 32 rejected Capgemini resources for Claims UX execution.
Align with Sarah Hudson on your design scope for the 90-day Claims UX quick wins pilot.
Rehearse the Architecture and Technology Strategy presentation to meet the strict five-minute-per-portfolio constraint for the upcoming executive review.
Establish the architectural partnership framework with the newly appointed Executive Director of Product Development for Property Lines.
